note: Digests of artifacts whose evidential value depends on being the one that was produced: a
blind review, a build's notes, and the expectations registered before each run.
This exists because comparing a file to HEAD only catches an UNCOMMITTED rewrite, and makes a
committed one the new reference. An audit demonstrated it: replacing a review, committing the
replacement, and re-running the check gave a clean pass. A normal CI checkout is already
committed, so the guard did not protect the evidence at the point the repository publishes it.
A digest recorded here has to be updated in the same commit as the file, which makes replacing
one a visible, reviewable act rather than an invisible one. That is the whole mechanism: it
cannot stop a determined rewrite, and it stops a silent one.
Appending a correction to a preserved artifact is legitimate (planted-defects.md gains labelled
corrections). Do it by adding to the file, updating the digest, and saying so in the commit —
never by editing what was produced. Errata for reviewer output go in a sibling ERRATA.md.
